ablation_operator_mismatch.description: The plan specifies per-stem mean-substitute (mean over OTHER 5 emotion variants of the SAME stem). The code uses a global mean over ALL 120 eval stems x 5 off-target emotions. This constant-offset substitution may INCREASE activations (if emotion-specific activation < global mean), producing wrong-sign delta. The same-emotion substitution bug does NOT apply — the code correctly uses others = [e_off for e_off in EMOTIONS if e_off != e]. But the global-scope bug is real.
ablation_operator_mismatch.operator_as_implemented: global mean over ALL stems and OTHER 5 emotions
ablation_operator_mismatch.operator_as_spec: per-stem mean over OTHER 5 emotion variants of the SAME stem

random_null_degenerate.description: null_delta_std = 0 (or machine epsilon) for all 6 emotions across 100 random draws. This suggests the per-layer aggregation of random component subsets produces a fixed aggregate delta regardless of which specific components are chosen (degenerate pool or layer-level summation effect). The null distribution is a degenerate point mass; z-scores are astronomically large (1e8 scale). The random-null anti-claim is therefore invalid.

note: Admitted with WARN. The not-supported verdict is a real experimental outcome given the implemented operator, but the operator deviation means the verdict may not reflect the underlying causal truth. C2 would be INTEGRITY_ONLY under max_verify_claims=1 cap (C3 is priority pick).
